props.note: Game addition: a [26,20,12] m build flank fragment of Beebe’s documented ~80 m-wide, ~50 m-high sulfide mound, with a tallest chimney, subsidiary spires, black particulate plumes and localized shrimp clusters. Stack heights and exact arrangement are scenic, not the full mound dimensions. Low-salinity fluids were measured around 401–403 °C and ~500 bar (Webber et al. 2015). See sources.md. Scenic addition: sparse tube-worm and mussel clumps on cooler flow margins, with broken chimney rubble; placement is illustrative, not a surveyed Beebe fauna census.

Second, shorter black-smoker chimney in the Beebe 1-5 mound cluster, same rationale as beebe-chimney-1. Scenic addition: sparse tube-worm and mussel clumps on cooler flow margins, with broken chimney rubble; placement is illustrative, not a surveyed Beebe fauna census.

Chimney on the western sulfide mound (bvf-sulfide-mound-west POI), representing one of at least six mounds mapped by Webber et al. (2015). Reconstruction: general mound location and count are sourced, this specific chimney's shape is not. Scenic addition: sparse tube-worm and mussel clumps on cooler flow margins, with broken chimney rubble; placement is illustrative, not a surveyed Beebe fauna census.
